records.title: 1488 White Blossom胜利后的地方转移
records.description: Ishyaga征服Abussa，Zulbur占领Rshak及Gasha；按此时对应国家残余持地映射，不扩展到全部旧核心。 本步骤为可关闭地图假说；选年与整省边界不等于已确证转属日期。原始native/tribal及投影不改。

sourceExpressions: 1485-1488 AA - Many Ashhana tribes refuse to receive the Zulburas cure. Because of Zulbur’s expansionist tendencies, many presume this is a part of a greater scheme to subjugate all Ashhana under Zulbur (or get mind controlled by the Night Hags to believe so). These tensions overflow into an open war called the War of Blossoms, as the Red Blossom alliance declares war on Zulbur and its ally Ishyaga.

The White Blossom emerges victorious in this war, partially because the Blood Curse cure banishes Night Hag influence, which caused mutinies to the White Blossom and partially due to Imperial Lizardfolk intervention, as Karashan joined the Red Blossom despite being under Rayaz administration.As a result of the war, Rayaz gains control over Lake Adgur and the village of Trellisk, Ishyaga conquers Abussa, while Zulbur occupies Rshak and Gasha.

sourceExpressions: 1521 AA - Zulbur, now under Sohrashru Iriktrask, proclaims that Ashhana are cured and that they have reached the state of balance between savagery and passion, beauty and mundane, mind and body. In unison with the chieftains of remaining tribes, he proclaims creation of Adzalan and abdicates from the throne.
